correctness.rationale: The least-valuation-pair argument proves no triple is VC-shattered; explicit cosets provide all pair traces. Primitive directions form a p+1-rooted, thereafter p-branched finite congruence tree of height e. Each pencil query selects one congruence cylinder. The all-positive path prevents shattered depth e+1 in a pencil; two untouched subtrees build depth e even with one excluded direction. A first-point split yields exact Ldim e+1. The independent finite bitset checker verifies traces, trees, and selected exact minimax ranks.

value.rationale: An entire natural family of primitive affine lines over finite chain rings has fixed VC dimension two and exact adaptive dimension e+1. The unbounded gap at fixed residue characteristic is a structural phenomenon explained by congruence-direction trees, not a small numerical increment or arbitrary object slicing.
